title: Interrupted training draft and relaunch
summary: Explore how a declared local training draft behaves when the app is interrupted and relaunched before or after an explicit save.
allowedActions: Reset the declared owned fixture and verify the selected app target
Open a new training plan and make local title, session, or exercise edits
Capture the pre-interruption hierarchy and terminate or background only the owned app instance
Relaunch the owned app, reopen the declared route, and inspect draft or discard state
Record visible state and read-only API/SQL evidence without changing expected behavior
excludedExternalEffects: Saving outside the declared fixture, direct database seeding as the behavior under test, or deleting unrelated plans
Purchases, account-role changes, provider mutations, automatic issue creation, or external notifications
Claiming persistence from UI state without the declared authenticated API or SQL read

scenario.title: An interrupted training draft follows the documented local and saved-state contract
preconditions: A fresh professional draft and authenticated read identity are available
The target app/build/connector are identified and reset evidence is current
The attempt declares whether interruption occurs before or after the explicit Save action
actions: Enter a title and one canonical session/item without saving
Capture the local draft state and interrupt the owned app
Relaunch and inspect the documented draft, guard, or route state
If the charter branch includes Save, verify the durable result through API and SQL
expectedObservations: Unsaved edits remain local until explicit Save
A discard guard is shown when leaving a draft with unsaved changes
Saved state can be distinguished from local draft state after relaunch
A missing or contradictory expectation is a documentation gap, not an invented defect
